summary: Grilled the workflow-modes capability spec. It defers all implementation (model, commands, size bound) to the plan/decision explicitly, and its acceptance criteria are behavioral. The one genuine capability-boundary question — the default posture across vendored clients — was put to the user and resolved.
gaps: Default posture across clients was the key capability boundary and had to be explicit: whether lite mode ships on-by-default, opt-in, or mandatory changes what every vendored client inherits.
resolutions: Confirmed on-by-default and removable: every vendored client inherits lite mode; a stricter shop disables it by removing the modes.lite pin (like any harness pin). The spec's Boundaries already states this posture.
